procedure_steps: Open Customer Profile Definition from the stated menu path.
Choose New mode and enter the required customer fields.
Save the profile and confirm the generated Customer ID.

notes_and_warnings.text: A profile cannot be saved until Customer ID, Customer Name, and Customer Type are present.
Modify mode changes take effect only after an authorized user approves the record.
Close mode is available only when the request has no pending approval.
